mentions.name: wehave.io
mentions.description: This B2B SaaS measures sponsorship ROI by combining data from clubs and sponsors to track conversion over time, attributing the select group of people who appear in both datasets.
mentions.problem: Sponsors spend millions on their sponsorships and have no idea what comes back; the challenge is attributing a select group of people who appear in both the club's and the sponsor's datasets.
mentions.audience: Sponsors (brands) and sports clubs measuring sponsorship impact
mentions.source_excerpt:
B2B SaaS for Sponsorship ROI measurement (https://wehave.io)

We use data from club & sponsor to measure conversion over time.
Our challenge lies in attributing a select group of people who appear in both datasets. Sponsors spend millions on their sponsorship, and they have no idea what comes back.
